Releases

The most recent releases, newest first. This is the only page that names versions. Each version links to its GitHub release; the changelog in the repository has the full entry.

On this page

VersionDateHeadline
1.0.362026-11-18A Cursor plugin package, install commands for the public repository, and a one-host-at-a-time Get started.
1.0.352026-11-18An opt-in merge when branch protection cannot be read, and local paths kept out of a goal’s pull request.
1.0.342026-11-18/sigma-init --antigravity writes the managed AGENTS.md block.
1.0.33 (no release page of its own)2026-11-15Append-only acceptance criteria, goals waiting on a closed goal are released, and follow-ups join their goal as slices.
1.0.322026-11-13The in-goal follow-up limit is a setting, followups.max_added_slices, default 10.
1.0.312026-11-13Goal runs honour a project’s recorded known-flake exception, and a --land run’s work survives its container.
1.0.302026-11-13The loop passes the merge stop line, and follow-ups become a setting.
1.0.292026-11-13Cloud sessions skip the setup wizard question, a branch-protection 403 falls back, and /sigma-orchestrate plans a batch.
1.0.282026-11-05A blocked goal is freed once its explicit blockers close.
1.0.272026-10-31Cloud --land waves, and a guide and readiness check for a cloud burst.
1.0.262026-10-29The resource guard: a held verify keeps its measurement and a cold verify gets more than one worker.
1.0.0 to 1.0.252026-10-07 to 2026-10-29The first public release, then the Decision Rulebook, branch upkeep, the stored dependency map and Sigma Chain, the resource guard, and the first cloud runs.
